data.one_liner: A layout-agnostic gooey and metaball effect widget for Flutter using fragment shaders.
data.what_it_does: Creates a liquid-like metaball visual effect by merging multiple widgets together using hardware-accelerated fragment shaders. It works with any widget arrangement as long as elements are descendants of a GooeyZone.
use_when: You want nearby UI elements to visually merge together like liquid.
You need hardware-accelerated metaball effects in Flutter layouts.
avoid_when: You have more than 10 GooeyBlob children inside a single GooeyZone.
Target platforms do not support GLSL fragment shaders.
strengths: Layout-agnostic, works with Row, Column, Stack, and Wrap widgets.
Hardware-accelerated rendering using GLSL fragment shaders.
Supports gradient fills and cutout blobs.
weaknesses: Limited to a maximum of 10 GooeyBlob children per GooeyZone.
data.minimal_example:
GooeyZone(
  color: Colors.indigo,
  gooiness: 30,
  child: Row(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      GooeyBlob(shape: const BlobShape.circle(), child: Icon(Icons.add)),
      GooeyBlob(shape: const BlobShape.circle(), child: Icon(Icons.edit)),
    ],
  ),
)
